parameters.name: AccelerationType
parameters.description:
The acceleration mode. Valid values:
- **whiltelist**: whitelist-based acceleration.
- **global**: global acceleration.
- **build-in-list**: built-in application acceleration.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the enterprise management policy. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length.

parameters.name: ShowInClient
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display the policy in the client. Valid values:
- **0**: not displayed.
- **1**: displayed.

parameters.name: UpstreamHost
parameters.description: The address (IP address or domain name) of the acceleration instance.

parameters.name: UpstreamPort
parameters.description: The port of the acceleration instance. Valid values: 1000 to 60000.
